spec.name: Furniture Spell Lectern
spec.description: A crooked dark-oak lectern supporting a thick open purple spellbook, brass clasps and a tiny green crystal. Stepped timber creates an asymmetric silhouette without rotations. Abstract spell marks only. Connected, stationary furniture contained within one block.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: dark crooked wooden spell lectern with a large open purple spellbook, gold clasps and tiny green crystal; abstract marks only, no readable text. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
